nodes.summary: Strassen's theorem on a finite poset `P`, for nonnegative vectors: if `μ` and `ν` have equal total mass and `ν(D) ≤ μ(D)` for every down-set `D`, there is a nonnegative `c` on the ordered pairs `x ≤ y` with first marginal `μ` and second marginal `ν`. This is the ordered-pair vector form of `MathlibExt.Probability.StrassenCouplingWanted.forall_isUpperSet_sum_le_iff_exists_coupling`.
nodes.title: Strassen's theorem

nodes.summary: Strassen's theorem for configurations on a finite set: if `μ ≼ ν` are probability measures on `ConfigSpace E`, there is a finite monotone coupling of `μ` and `ν` (V. Strassen, *The existence of probability measures with given marginals*, 1965). The converse is `StatMech.MonotoneCoupling.stochasticallyDominated`.
nodes.title: Strassen's theorem

nodes.summary: `D` is a down-set of `P`: `x ≤ y` and `y ∈ D` imply `x ∈ D`.
nodes.title: Down-set of a partial order

nodes.summary: The measure on pairs of configurations that puts mass `c q` on each ordered pair `q`.
nodes.title: Measure on ordered pairs from a mass vector

nodes.summary: The ordered pairs `(x, y)` with `x ≤ y`; couplings supported on the order are vectors indexed by `OrderPairs P`.
